definitions.explanation: The highest level of secrecy. Used for information, documents, plans, or projects that must not be disclosed under any circumstances. Stronger than 秘密 (secret).

examples.japanese: この{情報|じょうほう}は{極秘|ごくひ}だ。
{極秘|ごくひ}の{会議|かいぎ}が{行|おこな}われた。
{新製品|しんせいひん}の{開発|かいはつ}は{極秘|ごくひ}のプロジェクトとして{進|すす}められていた。
examples.english: The development of the new product was being carried out as a top-secret project.

notes:
FORMS:
- Modifier: {極秘|ごくひ}の + noun (top-secret ~)
- Predicate: {極秘|ごくひ}だ
- Adverbial: {極秘|ごくひ}に / {極秘|ごくひ}で (in secret, confidentially)

ETYMOLOGY:
{極|ごく} (extreme, utmost) + {秘|ひ} (secret). Literally "extremely secret."

USAGE:
Often used as a noun modifier with の: {極秘|ごくひ}の{書類|しょるい} (top-secret documents). Also appears as a stamp or label on documents: {極秘|ごくひ} (CONFIDENTIAL / TOP SECRET). Frequently used in business, government, and military contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {極秘|ごくひ}{情報|じょうほう}: top-secret information
- {極秘|ごくひ}{資料|しりょう}: classified documents
- {極秘|ごくひ}に{進|すす}める: to carry out in strict secrecy
- {極秘|ごくひ}{扱|あつか}い: classified treatment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {秘密|ひみつ}: secret (general, everyday)
- {機密|きみつ}: classified, confidential (official/institutional)
